# KumaonRang

> KumaonRang is Sneha's small shop in Pithoragarh, in the Kumaon division of Uttarakhand, India. It sells Aipan art frames and wall decor, Pahadi keychains and fridge magnets, bandarwars and home decor, personalised gifts and gift hampers. Orders are placed and confirmed on WhatsApp: Sneha confirms availability, the delivery charge and the total before the customer confirms. In-stock pieces dispatch in 2 to 3 days.

The name joins Kumaon, the region, with rang (रंग), Hindi for colour: the colours of Kumaon. Aipan is the red-and-white ritual folk art of Kumaon, white rice-paste line work on a red geru (ochre) ground.

- [Home decor](https://www.kumaonrang.com/home-decor): bandarwars (door hangings) and decor
